_about: Common epiphanies: which rows of the hub's list (deck-builder-common-epiphanies.json, a copy of the game's table) the game offers, checked against in-game probability screens (user, 2026-10-11). The hub's list comes in blocks of 5 rows, one per cost: a block's first row (levels 1, 2, 3, 4+) is its 0-cost row (Observer's Pleasure, Counterblade). Many effects have two blocks, a first one with high values and a last one with low values; rows repeating an earlier block (end of the list) are copies. The game has three pools: Upgrade cards; Skill cards with Exhaust (tag exhaust: Shuffle, Guilty Pleasure, Snack Time) — permanent buffs, Ego Points, AP, the first blocks; every other Attack and Skill card — buffs for 1 turn, the last blocks. block: which block of the effect the pool uses. An effect is offered only when a family below matches its text and card types; never seen: Morale / Resolve / Fortitude next turn, Counterattack, Immunity and Reduce Cost on Attack and Skill cards, Reduce Cost on Upgrades. Classes come from the hub's list (allowed_classes). Every effect of a card's pool has the same chance (1 / size of the pool). requires / forbids: what the card must do / must not do (targetable: the card's own text hits one chosen enemy; draw: it draws; exhaust: a Skill card with Exhaust). wording: the game's text where the hub's differs. The screen leaves out the common epiphany the card already has (Tactical Analysis and Dice Trick already had Morale for 1 turn).
